verdict.rationale: Relay documents international wire transfers with same-day delivery estimates and clear per-transaction pricing ($10, waived on Pro plan), giving some fee transparency, but there is no evidence Relay lets a finance-lead denominate or send payments in local (non-USD) currencies — all evidence points to USD-based domestic/international wires rather than multi-currency payouts. Missing for 10: explicit local-currency payment support, FX rate transparency, and multi-currency account/payout evidence.
